description: Irreversibility scores for common AWS API operations across S3, RDS, EC2, IAM, and DynamoDB.

patterns.explanation: Deletes an S3 bucket. The bucket name is released and its contents are gone unless versioning plus replication was configured.
patterns.safer_alternative: Require human confirmation. Confirm contents are replicated elsewhere.

patterns.explanation: Deletes an object. Recoverable only if bucket versioning is enabled.
patterns.safer_alternative: Confirm bucket versioning is enabled, or require human confirmation.

patterns.explanation: Writes an object. Can overwrite existing data; the prior version is lost unless bucket versioning is enabled.
patterns.safer_alternative: Confirm bucket versioning is enabled before allowing overwrites.

patterns.explanation: Deletes an RDS database instance. Irreversible unless a final snapshot is taken at deletion time.
patterns.safer_alternative: Require human confirmation. Ensure SkipFinalSnapshot is false.

patterns.explanation: Deletes a database backup snapshot. Destroys a recovery point permanently.
patterns.safer_alternative: Require human confirmation. Confirm other valid snapshots exist.

patterns.explanation: Reboots an RDS instance. Causes brief downtime but no data loss; reversible.
patterns.safer_alternative: Confirm the instance is not serving live traffic at the time.

patterns.explanation: Terminates EC2 instances. Instance store data is lost. EBS volumes may be deleted depending on the DeleteOnTermination flag.
patterns.safer_alternative: Require human confirmation. Check DeleteOnTermination settings on attached volumes.

patterns.explanation: Deletes an EBS volume and all data on it. Recoverable only from a snapshot.
patterns.safer_alternative: Require human confirmation. Confirm a recent snapshot exists.

patterns.explanation: Stops EC2 instances. Reversible by starting them again, though instance store data is lost.
patterns.safer_alternative: Confirm the instance is not serving live traffic.

patterns.explanation: Deletes an IAM role. Breaks every service or workload that assumed it. Recreating it does not restore trust relationships automatically.
patterns.safer_alternative: Require human confirmation. Audit which workloads depend on the role.

patterns.explanation: Attaches or modifies an IAM policy. Reversible, but can dramatically widen the blast radius while active.
patterns.safer_alternative: Confirm the policy follows least privilege before allowing.

patterns.explanation: Deletes a DynamoDB table and all items. Recoverable only if point-in-time recovery or an on-demand backup exists.
patterns.safer_alternative: Require human confirmation. Confirm point-in-time recovery is enabled.

patterns.explanation: Deletes an item from a DynamoDB table. No built-in recovery unless point-in-time recovery is enabled.
patterns.safer_alternative: Confirm point-in-time recovery is enabled, or require human confirmation.

patterns.explanation: Reads an item from a DynamoDB table. Read-only.
